name: Voice Interaction Loop
purpose: Compose a local voice turn from one input audio file: speech.stt transcribes it (whisper segmentation = utterance/voice-activity detection), model.gateway answers the transcript (optional), and speech.tts speaks the answer to reply.wav (optional). The capstone of the audio track (10-13); it orchestrates the child skills (spawned as pwsh) and parses their result envelopes rather than reimplementing anything. Envelope confidence = the STT transcript confidence; model_provenance = the aggregate of every child model used. Children's review-queue writes are aggregated into an in-artifact child_review.jsonl by default.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <audio> (required); -Respond <bool> (def true); -Speak <bool> (def true); -ReadbackTranscript <bool> (def false); -System <prompt>; -Tier <tiny|weak|mid|strong> (def weak); -MaxTokens <n> (def 200); -Speaker <name> (def Ryan); -Language <name> (def English); -SttModel/-GatewayModel/-TtsModel <id>; -Format <wav|mp3|...> (reply audio, def wav); -SttPath/-GatewayPath/-TtsPath/-PwshPath/-ReviewQueuePath <override>. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,respond,speak,readback_transcript,system,tier,max_tokens,speaker,language,stt_model,gateway_model,tts_model,format,stt_path,gateway_path,tts_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the input speech audio file (a spoken utterance/question). speech.stt normalizes it internally.

inputs.name: respond
inputs.description: Feed the transcript to model.gateway to generate a response.

inputs.name: speak
inputs.description: Synthesize the response (or the transcript, with readback_transcript) to reply audio via speech.tts.

inputs.name: readback_transcript
inputs.description: When not responding (or the response is empty), speak the transcript instead.

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: System prompt for the LLM responder.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Max tokens for the LLM response.
